# DocsBot AI

DocsBot AI enables the creation of custom chatbots trained on your documentation, facilitating automated customer support and content generation.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docsbot-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Bot**: Create a new bot within a team.
- **Delete Bot**: Delete a specific bot by its id.
- **Get Bot Details** (read-only): Fetch details of a specific bot by id within a team.
- **Get Team Details** (read-only): Fetch details of a specific team by its id.
- **List Bot Sources** (read-only): List all sources for a specific bot.
- **List Questions** (read-only): List all questions asked of a specific bot.
- **List Team Bots** (read-only): List all bots for a given team.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List all teams.
- **Update Bot**: Update specific fields for a bot (e.g., name, description, settings).
- **Update Team**: Update specific fields for a team.
- **Upload File to Cloud Storage**: Upload a file to cloud storage via a presigned url.
- **Generate Conversation Ticket**: Generate a structured support ticket from a chat agent conversation.
